title: Change Order Form
oneLiner: Free change order form maker for small contractors: write the change on the phone, send the homeowner a sign-off link, keep the signed record
customer: Small US service businesses and contractors
revenueModel: Free single change order with PDF; paid tier for saved jobs, client sign-off links with a timestamped record and team use

evidence.claim: JustSignOff sells change order sign-off for contractors from USD 49 flat with no free plan: customers approve, decline or ask for changes from a text or email link without an app, and approved orders become timestamped signed PDFs.
AddWork, an iPhone app for contractor estimates and change orders with client approval by link, charges USD 9.99 a month after a 14-day trial and has 10 ratings averaging 4.6.
Joist puts change orders on its Elite plan at USD 24 a month and has no free plan.
Fieldwire includes RFIs, submittals and change orders only from Business Plus at USD 89 a user a month; its free Basic plan has none of them.

nextAction: Screen passed on 2026-11-27. Ready for the CEO to staff. Overlaps work-order and rfi-log (same buyer); consider one product. The case must show pages we can rank against Housecall Pro, Smartsheet and template.net.

searches.note: DataForSEO Google Ads search volume (United States) through Firecrawl Alexandria, request 4908d495-cca6-4d96-82d7-3c3039db7ae2, read 2026-11-27. seodata.dev (cached 27 Sep 2026) shows construction change order 1,600 and change order 3,600 on the source page; change order alone is mixed with definition intent and is left out.

screen.freeGap: Free change order tools are downloads signed by hand: Housecall Pro gives an Excel or Google Sheets template behind a lead form with signature blocks (https://www.housecallpro.com/general-contractor/templates-calculators/free-change-order-template/), CountBricks a PDF with signature lines and e-sign only in its paid app after a 7-day trial (https://www.countbricks.com/post/free-change-order-forms-for-contractors). Paid tools sell the sign-off link: JustSignOff from USD 49 with no free plan (https://www.capterra.co.uk/software/1107866/JustSignOff), AddWork USD 9.99 a month after a 14-day trial (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/addwork/id6740415862), Fieldwire only on Business Plus at USD 89 a user (https://www.Fieldwire.Com/pricing/). The gap is a free change order with a homeowner approve link and a signed record, no account. Risk: Housecall Pro, Smartsheet, template.net and Jotform hold page one.
